The use of `b2sums` with full checksums (not SKIP) indicates an intent to verify source integrity, further supporting safe handling. There is no evidence of obfuscated code, unauthorized network access, or data exfiltration occurring at parse time.

Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no security risk.
